findings.highlight: a burning metal rod
findings.evidenceJa: 焼けた鉄の棒
findings.governingReading: Shirou imagines driving a red-hot iron rod into his spine.
findings.explanation: Generic metal removes the concrete iron material from the recurring bodily image.

findings.highlight: Tohsaka’s shoulders slump.
findings.evidenceJa: がっかりと肩を落とす遠坂。
findings.governingReading: The active source ends with Rin’s spoken realization; the disappointed shoulder-drop is commented out.
findings.explanation: mirror moon restores an obsolete physical-emotional cue.

findings.highlight: My throat hurts.
findings.evidenceJa: 食道がヒリヒリする
findings.governingReading: After swallowing the jewel, Shirou feels a stinging pain in his esophagus.
findings.explanation: Throat moves the pain upward and loses the internal path of the swallowed object.

findings.highlight: Straightforwardly.
findings.evidenceJa: しれっと
findings.governingReading: Rin reveals with an unconcerned, nonchalant manner that it was a jewel.
findings.explanation: Straightforwardly describes directness rather than her composed lack of concern.

findings.highlight: A lump of heat that can only be described as pain enters my back.
findings.evidenceJa: 背中には痛みとしか思えない熱さがかたまっている。
findings.governingReading: Painful heat is concentrated into a mass in Shirou’s back.
findings.explanation: Enters invents motion into the back and changes the bodily state.

findings.highlight: The difference between a magus and a human
findings.evidenceJa: 魔術師と人間の違い
findings.governingReading: Rin contrasts a magus with an ordinary person through the presence of a circuit switch.
findings.explanation: The English literally opposes magi to humans, implying the category distinction is species rather than capability.

findings.highlight: insulators and kettles
findings.evidenceJa: 電気ポットか保温瓶
findings.governingReading: Rin contrasts an electric pot that can boil water with a heat-retaining flask that cannot generate heat.
findings.explanation: Insulator is not the concrete flask in the analogy and breaks the parallel between two vessels.

findings.highlight: you’ll be like that forever
findings.evidenceJa: 士郎はずっとそのまま
findings.governingReading: The jewel keeps Shirou in the switched-on state until he turns it off himself.
findings.explanation: Forever overstates a condition immediately bounded by his own successful switch-off.

findings.highlight: the embarrassed Tohsaka is cute
findings.evidenceJa: 照れている遠坂をいいヤツだな
findings.governingReading: Shirou hazily thinks the embarrassed Rin is a good person.
findings.explanation: Cute converts moral appreciation of her help into romanticized physical appeal.

findings.highlight: approaches me, smiling
findings.evidenceJa: にやり、と笑って詰め寄ってくる
findings.governingReading: Rin smirks and presses in on Shirou as she proposes continuing the lesson.
findings.explanation: The generic smile and approach remove the predatory comic pressure.

findings.highlight: the “strengthening” failed in spite of that
findings.evidenceJa: 一回も“強化”が成功しなかった
findings.governingReading: Not one of Shirou’s attempts at Strengthening succeeded.
findings.explanation: The English loses the explicit zero-success count that explains the thirty broken lamps.

findings.highlight: it’s magic that reproduces something
findings.evidenceJa: 物を複製するって魔術
findings.governingReading: Rin defines Projection as Magecraft that reproduces an object.
findings.explanation: Generic magic erases the technical category in a formal system explanation.

findings.highlight: ten magical energy
findings.evidenceJa: 十の魔力
findings.governingReading: Rin compares a projected sword built with ten units of magical energy against a strengthened sword using one.
findings.explanation: The uncountable noun is used as a bare count, obscuring the quantitative comparison.

findings.highlight: Saber is waiting for me at the doorway.
findings.evidenceJa: 縁側でセイバーが俺の帰りを待っていた。
findings.governingReading: Saber waits for Shirou on the engawa/veranda.
findings.explanation: Doorway moves her to a different architectural location.

findings.highlight: enforcing the weak spots in the object
findings.evidenceJa: 物の弱い箇所を補強する
findings.governingReading: Rin told Shirou to reinforce the object’s weak points.
findings.explanation: Enforcing is the wrong operation and makes the practical Strengthening advice nonsensical.

findings.highlight: he is so correct, I can’t answer
findings.evidenceJa: その通りなんで反論しようがない
findings.governingReading: Because Archer is exactly right, Shirou has no way to argue back.
findings.explanation: The English construction is unidiomatic and weakens the reluctant concession.

findings.highlight: I’ll take it right now, free of charge.
findings.evidenceJa: 今なら買うぞ、二束三文で。
findings.governingReading: Shirou extends the idiom of buying a fight by saying he will buy it cheaply, for a trifling price.
findings.explanation: Free reverses the stated comic price and damages the wordplay.

findings.highlight: a fight has to be exchange of blows
findings.evidenceJa: 戦うなら殴り合うしかない
findings.governingReading: Shirou insists that if they fight, it can only mean exchanging blows.
findings.explanation: The missing article leaves the sentence visibly malformed.

findings.highlight: the kindness of Rin has transferred to me
findings.evidenceJa: 凛の甘さが移ったようだ
findings.governingReading: Archer says Rin’s softness or leniency seems to have rubbed off on him.
findings.explanation: Kindness moralizes the trait and weakens his self-reproach for showing mercy to an enemy.

findings.highlight: the words that linger horribly in my head
findings.evidenceJa: やけに頭に残るアーチャーの台詞
findings.governingReading: Archer’s words remain unusually, insistently vivid in Shirou’s mind.
findings.explanation: Horribly adds a negative emotional judgment absent from the source.
